decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records accounting for coded and randomly assigned rewards on leaderboards and NFT attributes, including ticket-commission pairing.
The FAQ already states that no-code mints assign both the commission and tickets randomly; the source decision concerns aggregate accounting rather than FAQ copy.
A same-message MODIFY already confirms one $5 commission and one ticket randomly assigned for every no-code primary mint, followed by RESUME.
The source explicitly says coded-referral rewards are correctly accounted for and does not change the existing $5 commission or one-ticket award.
The accounting-total clarification does not alter the existing $15 mint split or any revenue-allocation amount.
The existing invalid-or-no-code message already describes a $5 commission and $500 ticket going to a random existing NFT holder; no feedback wording is changed.
Referral ticket and commission accounting does not change the separate $5-per-mint prize-pool contribution or its funding sources.
Accounting rewards on NFT attributes does not change the rule that each NFT's own mint number is its referral code.
The source decision addresses referral rewards and aggregate displays, not optional tips or their separate transaction flow.
The requirement to deliver the NFT after minting remains unchanged by the referral reward accounting rule.
The source is an operational accounting clarification and does not request a change to landing-page mechanics copy.
Referral reward totals do not change when mint-success feedback may be displayed.
